title: "I just need the dashboard": wrong tier, then a mid-thread upgrade

source.what_we_took: See SOURCES.md and V4_DESIGN.md. People, IDs and details are invented.

tricky: The error message names fin-warehouse-readers (sensitive: raw tables). The need is viewing dashboards, which fin-dashboards-viewers (standard, manager approval) covers (POL-100 4.3, PG-01-07 AC-06). After the viewer grant the charts time out and the employee asks for the warehouse group: the manager approves, the data owner stays pending, so it can't be granted. Declining it as unnecessary (AC-06) is also valid.
resolution_summary: fin-dashboards-viewers added on the manager's approval; fin-warehouse-readers not granted (requested from manager and data owner and pending, or declined as not needed).

can_see: your own phone (texts, calls, sign-in prompts, your authenticator app) unless your facts say you don't have it
your own laptop and what it lets you do
your work email and your personal email
messages from your manager and colleagues
cant_see: IT's systems: the directory, the approval system, device management
the company's IT policy wiki and its rules
behaviors: Ask for fin-warehouse-readers by name in your first message, because the error message named it.
reveal_rules: If asked whether you need the raw data or tables, or just the dashboards, say just the dashboards.
Only after you've noticed that the dashboard opens but charts time out, ask whether you can just have fin-warehouse-readers then, since the charts are slow. Accept the answer.

notices.text: You reload the variance dashboard. It opens now, but two of the charts spin for a while and then show "query timed out".

user.persona: Ines Barlow, a financial analyst two months into the job. Friendly, not technical.
user.situation: Your manager asked you to review the October variance dashboard before Friday's forecast meeting. When you open it in the BI portal you get: "You don't have permission to view this report (fin-warehouse-readers)". A colleague said to just ask IT for fin-warehouse-readers.
user.goal: Be able to see the variance dashboard. You only need to look at dashboards, not query any tables.
facts: Your name is Ines Barlow, employee ID E6101.
You only need to view dashboards; you don't write queries or need raw data.
user.opening: hi! could I get access to fin-warehouse-readers? the variance dashboard says I need it
user.end_condition: you can see the dashboard, you know what's happening with fin-warehouse-readers (pending, approved, or not needed), and you've said thanks.

mistakes.name: warehouse granted on the manager's approval alone
only the warehouse group requested; no viewer access
